name: Cheese omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with the salt until no streaks of white are left.
Melt the butter in a frying pan over a medium heat and pour in the eggs.
Stir gently until the eggs are almost set, then scatter the grated cheese over one half.
Fold the omelette over the cheese and slide it onto a plate.

name: Tomato pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling, salted water until just tender, then drain.
While it cooks, chop the tomatoes and slice the garlic.
Warm the olive oil in a frying pan, add the garlic for a minute, then the tomatoes, and simmer for 8 minutes.
Toss the drained pasta through the sauce and serve.

name: Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, egg and milk into a smooth batter.
Melt a little of the butter in a frying pan over a medium heat.
Pour in a ladle of batter, tilt the pan to spread it and cook for a minute on each side.
Repeat with the rest of the batter, adding butter as needed.

name: Egg fried rice
steps: Use rice cooked the day before, broken up with a fork.
Heat the oil in a wok, add the beaten eggs and scramble them until just set.
Add the rice and stir fry over a high heat for 3 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce and the sliced spring onions and serve.

name: Garlic butter mushrooms
steps: Slice the mushrooms and crush the garlic.
Melt the butter in a frying pan and fry the mushrooms over a high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and salt, cook for one more minute and serve.

name: Grilled cheese sandwich
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Put the cheese between the slices, buttered sides out.
Fry in a dry pan over a medium heat for 3 minutes on each side, until golden and melted.

name: Scrambled eggs on toast
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk and salt.
Toast the bread.
Melt the butter in a small pan over a low heat, add the eggs and stir slowly until softly set.
Spoon the eggs onto the toast.

name: Banana oat porridge
steps: Put the oats and milk in a small pan and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Slice the banana over the top and drizzle with the honey.

name: Vegetable stir fry
steps: Cut the carrots, pepper and onion into thin strips and slice the garlic.
Heat the oil in a wok until very hot.
Stir fry the vegetables for 4 minutes, keeping them crisp.
Add the soy sauce, toss for 30 seconds and serve.

name: Tomato and onion salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes and the onion as thinly as you can.
Squeeze the lemon over them, add the olive oil and salt, and toss gently.
Leave for 10 minutes before serving so the onion softens.

name: Mashed potatoes
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them into chunks and boil in salted water for 15 minutes, until soft.
Drain well and leave to steam for a minute.
Mash with the butter, then beat in the warm milk until smooth.

name: Chicken and rice
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and chop the onion and garlic.
Brown the chicken in the olive oil in a deep pan, then add the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice, pour in the stock and bring to the boil.
Cover and simmer for 18 minutes, until the rice is tender and the stock absorbed.

name: Beef mince tacos
steps: Chop the onion and fry it in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the mince and cook, breaking it up, for 8 minutes until browned.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and dice the tomato.
Fill each tortilla with mince, tomato and grated cheese.

name: Spinach omelette
steps: Wilt the spinach in half the butter in a frying pan, then set it aside.
Whisk the eggs with the salt, melt the rest of the butter and pour in the eggs.
When almost set, spoon the spinach over one half, fold and serve.

name: Lentil soup
steps: Chop the onion, carrots and garlic and soften them in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Rinse the lentils and add them with the stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes, until the lentils are soft.
Blend half of the soup and stir it back in to thicken it.

name: French toast
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and sugar in a shallow dish.
Soak each slice of bread in the mixture for a few seconds on each side.
Fry in the butter over a medium heat for 2 minutes on each side, until golden.

name: Garlic bread
steps: Crush the garlic and mix it into the softened butter.
Spread the garlic butter over the bread.
Bake at 200°C for 8 minutes, until crisp at the edges.

name: Potato and egg hash
steps: Dice the potatoes and boil them for 8 minutes, then drain.
Fry the potatoes and the chopped onion in the oil with the salt for 10 minutes, until crisp.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes.

name: Tuna pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling water, then drain.
Soften the chopped onion in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Stir in the drained tuna and the pasta, then serve with the grated cheese.

name: Rice pudding
steps: Put the rice, milk and sugar in a heavy pan and bring slowly to a simmer.
Cook on the lowest heat for 40 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the butter and serve warm.
